items.title: Brian Thomas: Should be fine after shoulder scare
items.description:
Coach Liam Coeh said that Thomas is "alright" after falling on his shoulder in practice, and the team will now focus on getting him ready for Week 1 against the Browns, Mia O'Brien of 1010 XL 92.5 FM Jacksonville reports.

items.title: Tyler Warren: Remains out with groin issue
items.description:
Warren (groin) may not practice this week as the team prepares to have him available for the season opener, Jake Arthur of Roundtable Sports  reports.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Dealing with minor ankle injury
items.description:
Henderson has been diagnosed with a lower right ankle injury and will undergo further "precautionary" tests, Christopher Price of the Boston Globe reports.

items.title: Alec Pierce: May practice this week
items.description:
Pierce (ankle) will not practice Tuesday, but coach Shane Steichen said he's hopeful that the wideout will practice this week, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Remains sidelined by toe issue
items.description:
